portInfo.description: Two geographies share this SeaDays slug: the seaside/ferry district of Travemünde and the UNESCO-listed Hanseatic Altstadt inland. Do not invent a dock-to-Holstentor walk.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Hanseatic City of Lübeck (UNESCO WH Altstadt)
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm Travemünde vs any inner-Lübeck landing before planning.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: LHG cruise terminals (Lübeck / Travemünde complex) — Lübecker Hafen-Gesellschaft terminals incl. Travemünde area
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Altstadt needs a transfer from Travemünde docks — no invented minutes.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Altstadt needs a transfer from Travemünde docks — no invented minutes.
